label: WaterMelonControl
description: WaterMelonControl adds Karoo data page widgets for sideloaded media apps, including now playing, playback controls, tap-to-open, and device music volume control.
releaseNotes:
### Karoo 2 beta02

- Removes beta01 diagnostic logging.
- Adds Android 8/Oreo-only media fallbacks for Karoo 2.
- Adds passive Bluetooth AVRCP metadata receiver for phone-to-Karoo playback metadata.
- Adds legacy Android media broadcast receiver for older sideloaded players.
- Prefers media-key dispatch for play/pause/next/previous on Android 8 to preserve confirmed Karoo 2 control behavior.
- Karoo 3 path remains unchanged; fallbacks return immediately on newer Android versions.
